findings.source_quote: κατὰ τὸ τάγμα ὡς ἕκαστος ἔδωκε τὰς ῥάβδους.
findings.english_quote: Call them rank by rank, in the same order in which each man handed over his rod.
findings.issue: The source says that each handed over “the rods,” plural. The simplified edition changes this to one rod per man, although it retains “your own rods” in the following instruction. This introduces a numerical restriction not expressed by the selected wording.
findings.suggested_revision: Preserve the plural, for example: “Call them rank by rank, in the same order in which each man handed over his rods.” This proposal requires fresh review.

findings.source_quote: εἶτα ἐπέδωκαν οἱ τὰς ἡμιξήρους καὶ σχισμὰς ἐχούσας·
findings.english_quote: Next came those whose rods had been half dry and cracked.
findings.issue: The source states that this group handed in their rods. “Next came” substitutes an arrival or procession for that action and omits the explicit handing-in clause. The later statement that many handed in green rods does not cover the initial action attributed to the group as a whole.
findings.suggested_revision: Restore the action, for example: “Then those whose rods had been half dry and cracked handed them in.” This proposal requires fresh review.

summary: The standard edition faithfully covers the supplied working source; its bracketed instances of “rods” make explicit an understood noun rather than claim additional preserved Greek text. The simplified edition needs correction to retain the plural rods in section 2 and the handing-in action in section 6. Both preserve the speakers, group distinctions, and negations. No alternative readings or manuscript reports were supplied, and this review does not authenticate the named source edition or unseen manuscripts.
